title: Red Hat Security Advisory: java-25-openjdk security update for RHEL 10
description: Red Hat has issued a critical security update for the java-25-openjdk packages in Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. This update addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the OpenJDK 25 Java Runtime Environment and Software Development Kit, including enhancements and fixes related to Kerberos tickets, TLS connections, StringBuilder checks, JFR events, loop handling, vector masks, integer compression, JMX connections, Base64 optimization, and TLS client connections. Additionally, a bug fix disables post-quantum hybrid key exchange in TLS 1.3 when running in FIPS mode to prevent negotiation failures. The update is rated critical due to the nature of the vulnerabilities fixed.
